items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: I only worked with him that once, anyway.

ctx.x: But now how did you feel about working for Norman Gram ? How did Norman, or Mr. Gram , that is, come off to you?
Well, there wasn't -- as far as I was concerned, there wasn't any problems personally or what have you. Just another fella, as far as I'm concerned. I only worked with him that once, anyway.
